articles.title: Why are the Red Sox connected to so many shortstops in trade rumors?
articles.summary: Boston might already have everything its looking for right at home.
articles.body:
Something curious is happening and I can't quite figure out why. Ever since the World Series ended, there's been a new source of smoke almost every day about the Red Sox trading for a shortstop. As best I can tell, it started on the morning of Halloween, when Rob Bradford made this post:

Then the following day, Jim Bowden — who should always be taken with a grain of salt — added CJ Abrams to the list of Red Sox trade targets along with doubling down on the De La Cruz rumors.

Now in the last 36 hours, there's also been rumblings of the Otto Lopez rumors. Yesterday on the Felger & Mazz program , Jimmy Stewart even said he would prefer Lopez to De La Cruz because De La Cruz is "more sizzle than steak."

This isn't the first time the Red Sox have been connected to Lopez either. Back at the deadline, Jeff Passan even floated a deal that centered around Lopez and Liam Hicks from the Marlins before the Sox eventually landed on Adley Rutschman.

But as we've been learning recently, the Marlins don't seem interested in playing ball here, so we'll have to wait and see if this part of the conversation has any sticking power.

Anyway, while we're waiting, I'd like to suggest a name I'd be interested in seeing as the new Red Sox shortstop going forward: Franklin Arias. (My sources indicate that Worcester is willing to move him for a far cheaper price than any of the trade packages involving De La Cruz, Abrams, or Lopez from Cincinnati, Washington, or Miami.)

But seriously, why are the majority of the Red Sox rumors out of the offseason gate centered around shortstop?

I understand why this was the case in July: Arias wasn't ready for a postseason run in 2026, question marks surrounded Trevor Story's return (something I got wrong), and Andruw Monasterio can't hack defensively at short. So yeah, given what we thought the Red Sox might be able to do in October off the back of the 15-game winning streak, it made sense to go nuts.

But now that 2026 is over and our eyes are centered on whenever baseball returns in 2027 (or beyond), why is Franklin Arias not the plan moving forward? He's the No. 2 prospect in the sport! And just to be clear here, we're not talking within the Red Sox system, we're talking among all 30 teams in baseball. He is, BY FAR the best thing the Red Sox have going down on the farm right now (their only other guy in the top 100 is Justin Gonzales, who's only played 18 games above High-A and ranks No. 71).

Any furthermore, I don't think people truly appreciate how far Arias is tracking ahead of where Marcelo Mayer was in recent seasons. In Double-A Portland, Arias posted a .952 OPS in 380 plate appearances (many in horrible, wintry, early season conditions). Mayer meanwhile put up a .763 OPS in 524 plate appearances in Portland.

In Worcester, it appears a little bit closer (Arias has an .894 OPS there to Mayer's .835) until you take into account that Arias achieved that line a full two years young than Mayer (his age 20 season compared to Mayer's age 22 season). And also, by all accounts, the defense isn't close either. Arias is far superiors.

So I guess my question is: Why isn't Arias being hyped as the shortstop of the future? Did the Mayer experience just burn people to such a degree they now think Arias will turn out the same way because he plays the same position and that Roman Anthony will have the same personality because they were friends? I can't believe I'm saying this, because the opposite is true 99 percent of the time, but I feel like this fan base is now underrating our potential future stars.

Franklin Arias turns 21 later this month. Roman Anthony will still be just 22 on Opening Day (if Opening Day happens on time), and the Red Sox control each of them for at least the next six seasons (probably more) at a reasonable price. Why isn't this being hyped as the future or "the A-Team" if you want to get cute?

According to these rumors, the Red Sox need a shortstop and a big bat. Except for the fact, they may already have these things — Cost controlled, young, and with the ability to get better. Franklin Arias is already a better defensive shortstop right now than De La Cruz will ever be. Despite a disappointing 2026, Roman Anthony already has a higher career OPS than De La Cruz at the major league level, and is two years young.

So, I have to wonder, what are we even doing here? The last three teams standing in the MLB postseason this year ranked 22nd (Rays), 27th (Guardians) and tied for 28th / 29th (Brewers) in home runs. Other than Junior Caminero, who went deep 42 times, not a single other player on any of these teams had more than 26 home runs.

The Red Sox ranked 26th in home runs this year, so they fit right in, and while I understand and support the idea of more power in the lineup, I don't think it needs to come from shortstop, and there's no way in hell I'd give up on Anthony at this stage of his career.

But at the same time, these rumors aren't coming from nowhere, so I have to wonder what's going on. Are the Red Sox about to give up on a promising future mere moments away from when it's about to pay dividends, because that's largely what these rumors feel like in recent days. If that happens,, and either of these guys pan out elsewhere, I'll be furious for years to come. There's nothing worse than waiting years for something potentially great and then bailing on it last minute. If that happens, the dreams of the Red Sox future will quickly turn into a nightmare.

articles.title: ESPN analyst makes bold claim about the Vikings' offense
articles.summary: The Vikings' offensive struggles date back to the beginning of the 2025 season.
articles.body:
The Minnesota Vikings ' offense has struggled mightily through seven games in 2026. Despite their 6-1 record, the offense ranks 29th in yards and 27th in points. Although the running game hasn't been efficient enough (tied for 26th in EPA/rush), the passing game hasn't been much better (24th in EPA/pass).

ESPN's Dan Orlovsky appeared on The Pat McAfee Show on Monday and pointed out that the Vikings' passing-game struggles date back to the start of the 2025 season.

"Since Sam Darnold left Minnesota, as a team, [they have] the worst QBR in football," Orlovsky said . "So no, this is not just Kyler [Murray]. Okay. We've had multiple quarterbacks play in the situation. It's not just him right now. This offense, on a drive-by-drive basis, is the worst offense in football. They averaged 24 yards per drive with [Jordan] Addison, [Justin] Jefferson, [T.J.] Hockenson, [Christian] Darrisaw, and Aaron Jones, who's still plenty capable."

Murray's status for Monday's game against the Buffalo Bills is in question after Kevin O'Connell told reporters on Monday that the quarterback is dealing with a sore hamstring. If Murray can't play, then Carson Wentz will return to the lineup for his second start of the season and his seventh since the beginning of last year.

Regardless of who is under center, O'Connell and his staff have to fix things fast if they want to do any damage in the playoffs.

articles.title: ISSF World Championships: Jaypal Malviya scripts history with silver, secures India's first shooting quota for LA 2028
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Jaypal Malviya announced his arrival on the big stage with a breakthrough silver medal in the men's 10m air pistol event at the ISSF World
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Jaypal Malviya announced his arrival on the big stage with a breakthrough silver medal in the men's 10m air pistol event at the ISSF World Championships in Doha on Thursday, securing India's first shooting quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.The shooter from Madhya Pradesh produced a composed performance in the eight-man final, scoring 242.2 points to finish second behind China's Kai Hu, who clinched gold with 243.9. Czechia's Jindrich Dubovy took bronze with 220.9.The silver was doubly significant for India as it brought the country's first Olympic quota in shooting for the Los Angeles Games. Malviya's achievement also marked a major breakthrough in his young career, having made his mark on the national circuit only recently."The environment is great. The crowd was very loud and motivated me. I would like to thank the federation, SAI, OGQ and the MP and Indian government. I am grateful to Samaresh Jung sir. I feel great that I could bring the quota and medal to the country," Malviya said after the final.Malviya holds nerve in tense finalMalviya had qualified for the final in third place with a score of 585 across six series, setting himself up for a shot at the podium.The Indian endured a mixed start in the final, shooting 9.2 on his second attempt in the opening five-shot series before recovering with a 10.6 on his final shot. He finished the series with 50.5 points, occupying third place behind leader Hu.He briefly slipped to fourth after his 10-shot series, with a total of 100.0, as Dubovy moved into third with 100.5. China's Hu and Yu Xie continued to set the pace.However, Malviya responded with a 10.7 to stay in contention, drawing loud cheers from the crowd. He followed it up with another 10.7 as Hu shot 10.9, leaving the Indian just 0.5 points behind the Chinese shooter.The result also assured India of its first shooting quota for the 2028 Olympics. Malviya remained in the medal hunt as the final entered its decisive stages, with a narrow gap separating him from Hu.A 9.7 threatened to derail his challenge, putting him 0.9 points behind the leader. But the Indian bounced back with a crucial 10.7 to keep the pressure on. Hu eventually held on for gold, while Dubovy secured bronze.From national trials to World Championships podiumMalviya has emerged as one of the promising names in Indian shooting. He first made a strong impression at the 2026 National Selection Trials, winning the men's 10m air pistol Trial 1 gold at the Dr Karni Singh Shooting Range in New Delhi.After qualifying seventh, he produced an impressive 245.6 in the final to claim the title. He also finished ninth at the 2026 ISSF World Cup in Hangzhou, narrowly missing the final despite shooting 585 in qualification.The World Championships silver and Olympic quota now represent the biggest milestones of his career, putting him firmly on the road to Los Angeles 2028.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: 3 Best MLB Free Agent Fits For Japanese Superstar Teruaki Sato
articles.summary: Here are the three best MLB free agent fits for Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato, who has ripped the cover off the ball.
articles.body: It's a shot in the dark, but it's a compelling one! Japanese third baseman Teruaki Sato was recently posted for MLB teams to sign. The 27-year-old has potent power from the left side of the plate, has also extensively played right field and was the recipient of the 2025 Central League Most Valuable Player Award. For a team seeking a shot in the arm and a player who could be a franchise building block, Sato is a tantalizing player to take a chance on. Here are the three best MLB free agent fits for Sato: Philadelphia Phillies Sato could inject life into a Phillies offense that needs it. For starters, Phillies infielders Alec Bohm, Edmundo Sosa and midseason pickup Luis Arráez are free agents, which provides a clear roadmap to Sato opening the 2027 season at the hot corner. Elsewhere, Trea Turner is coming off arguably the worst season of his MLB career (-0.1 wins above replacement, a .675 OPS and -17 defensive runs saved at shortstop), catcher J.T. Realmuto hit just .205 in 2026 and the Phillies struggled immensely to get production from their outfield aside from Bryce Harper, who moved back to right field during the summer. Over the last two seasons alone (2025-26), Sato, who has power to all fields and crushes pitches in the upper half of the strike zone, averaged 39.5 home runs and 104 RBIs per year for the Hanshin Tigers. Last season, he posted a .306/.383/.609 slash line, with all three percentages being career highs. Sato could add considerable power to a Philadelphia offense that's in need of just that. Last season, the Phillies were just 24th in MLB in slugging percentage (.395), 23rd in on-base percentage (.312), 22nd in hits (1,301), 19th in runs (713) and tied for 16th in home runs (182). Moreover, they were 25th in barrel percentage (7.1%), according to Statcast. All that said, Philadelphia may opt to re-sign two of the three aforementioned free agent infielders and make a major investment or two in its bullpen, which was 21st in the sport with a 4.43 ERA. Maybe the Phillies will also pursue a new center fielder instead of a new third baseman? Seattle Mariners The Seattle Mariners went from being one win away from their first-ever American League pennant to winning just 76 games. They need a boost, and Sato would suffice — and then some. Seattle acquired Brendan Donovan, a 2025 All-Star and a 2022 Gold Glover, from the St. Louis Cardinals to play third base last season, but he was limited to 38 games due to groin and head injuries, respectively. Donovan has also played second base, left field and right field. In other words, Donovan could open 2027 as the Mariners' first infielder off the bench and take over at second base for Cole Young or at third base for Sato if either struggles. Donovan could also potentially be the team's left fielder if they don't retain Randy Arozarena. Sato, who hit three doubles and posted a .300/.417/.600 slash line for Japan in the 2026 World Baseball Classic, would provide a jolt to a Seattle offense that was just 29th in MLB in batting average (.233), 28th in runs (664), hits (1,253) and slugging percentage (.379) and tied for 16th in home runs (182) last season. The reality is any team signing a player on an international basis in the prime of their professional career is a risk, but the Mariners are in a position to take that chance because they need the offense and have an immediate role for Sato. All that said, Seattle may think Sato's impact wouldn't definitively supersede a healthy Donovan at third base, could prioritize re-signing Arozarena and bank on bouncing back as a whole in 2027; the San Diego Padres, who missed the playoffs in 2021 and 2023 but have made the playoffs in every other season since 2020, would be a model for this thinking. New York Yankees The Yankees don't have a hindrance in the way of making Sato their everyday third baseman. Sure, Ryan McMahon is under contract for one more season and due $16 million. At the same time, McMahon, a traditionally stellar third baseman, hit just .213 last season and is tailor-made for a utility role, as he also played second base with the Colorado Rockies before landing in the Bronx during the 2025 season, while also dabbling at first base. Plus, New York has an opening at second base, as Jazz Chisholm Jr. is a free agent and, while he got playing time at the middle infield position down the stretch of last season, Anthony Volpe's future as an MLB starter is in doubt given the arrival of touted shortstop George Lombard Jr. McMahon could slide over to second if injury presents itself. Sato would potentially be another explosive left-handed hitter for an already reputable Yankees' lineup in that regard (e.g., Ben Rice, Cody Bellinger and Spencer Jones). Now, if you asked Grok to define "feast or famine," it may spit out the Yankees' 2026 offensive production. Seriously, it's that bizarre. While New York's offense was first in MLB in barrel percentage (9.6%), second in home runs (223), tied for second in average exit velocity (89.6 mph), third outright in hard-hit percentage (41.6%) and tied for sixth in slugging percentage (.409), it was also 29th in hits (1,250), 26th in batting average (.235) and recorded the sixth-most strikeouts (1,480). In all, the Yankees finished in a three-way tie for ninth with 739 runs scored, which they followed by tallying just five runs and 12 hits in the AL Division Series, which saw them get swept by the eventual AL-champion Tampa Bay Rays. Aaron Judge is the best position player in the sport, but the three-time AL MVP turns 35 next April, appeared in just 66 games last season due to rib and calf injuries and has been held back by injury in multiple seasons (2018, 2019, 2020 and 2023, as well). The Yankees have to be prepared for Judge to miss time, and that doesn't just mean stocking up their outfield depth. Rather, it also means finding ways to increase production from other positions, and New York has the flexibility to upgrade at both second base and third base. Sato is a risk worth taking for the Yankees. articles.title: La despedida de James Rodríguez a Cristiano Ronaldo tras su adiós a Portugal
articles.standfirst: Las palabras de James Rodríguez que conmovieron a Cristiano Ronaldo tras su retiro de la selección
articles.summary: Las palabras de James Rodríguez que conmovieron a Cristiano Ronaldo tras su retiro de la selección
articles.body: El mundo del fútbol se ha estremecido con una noticia que marca el fin de una era dorada en el balompié internacional: Cristiano Ronaldo anunció oficialmente su retiro de la Selección de Portugal a sus 41 años. Tras más de dos décadas defendiendo los colores lusos, el astro portugués decidió colgar los botines a nivel de selecciones con una emotiva carta abierta. Las reacciones del planeta fútbol no se hicieron esperar, y una de las más destacadas provino de Sudamérica: el mediocampista colombiano James Rodríguez se sumó a los múltiples homenajes con un mensaje inolvidable que resalta la grandeza de 'CR7'. El histórico capitán portugués oficializó su salida definitiva del combinado nacional tras un largo recorrido repleto de récords, capitanías memorables y el histórico título de la Eurocopa 2016. A través de sus redes sociales, Cristiano expresó su orgullo por haber representado a su país durante 23 años y agradeció a sus seres queridos y fanáticos por el respaldo incondicional. "Tuve el privilegio de ser su capitán, pero ningún capitán camina solo", destacó el delantero en su comunicado de despedida, generando una ola de reacciones y tributos por parte de los clubes más importantes del mundo, leyendas del deporte y figuras internacionales. Entre las muestras de respeto y admiración internacional, las palabras del volante colombiano James Rodríguez captaron la atención de la prensa deportiva. Aunque ambos compartieron momentos de máxima exigencia en la élite europea y han mantenido una relación de respeto mutuo a lo largo de los años, el mensaje del cucuteño reflejó la profunda admiración que siente la generación dorada del fútbol mundial hacia el legado de Cristiano. “Leyenda”, escribió en el mensaje que publicó Cristiano Ronaldo. Figuras de la talla de James han reconocido en reiteradas ocasiones el impacto que la ética de trabajo, la disciplina y la consistencia de Ronaldo han tenido en los futbolistas contemporáneos. Su mensaje se convirtió rápidamente en tendencia en las redes sociales, uniendo a la afición colombiana y portuguesa en un mismo sentimiento de gratitud hacia el eterno '7'. El adiós de Cristiano Ronaldo deja un vacío gigante en las competiciones de selecciones, pero su nombre ya se encuentra grabado de forma permanente en la historia dorada del deporte rey. Mientras Portugal inicia una nueva etapa generacional, las palabras de figuras como James Rodríguez reafirman que el impacto de CR7 va mucho más allá de los títulos y los récords: es un ícono global que marcó a toda una generación de jugadores en cada rincón del planeta.

articles.title: Kevin Viveros recibe duras críticas tras pisar a un rival en el estómago
articles.standfirst: Inminente sanción para Kevin Viveros en Brasil tras violenta agresión a un rival
articles.summary: Inminente sanción para Kevin Viveros en Brasil tras violenta agresión a un rival
articles.body: El delantero colombiano Kevin Viveros pasa de la gloria a la controversia en el fútbol brasileño. El atacante del Athletico Paranaense se encuentra en el centro de un intenso debate mediático e institucional tras protagonizar una dura acción en la que pisó a un rival en el estómago, jugada por la cual vio la tarjeta roja directa y ahora afronta una inminente y drástica sanción en el Brasileirão. Una jugada imprudente que enciende las alarmas en el Brasileirão El momento de tensión se vivió durante el encuentro frente a Vasco da Gama (partido que terminó con derrota 3-1 para el conjunto de Paranaense). Sobre el minuto 31 del segundo tiempo, en plena disputa por el esférico con el jugador Cuiabano, Viveros protagonizó un desafortunado forcejeo que terminó con el colombiano pisando de manera antirreglamentaria el abdomen de su adversario. El árbitro principal del compromiso, Ramón Abatti Abel, no dudó tras revisar la jugada y le mostró la tarjeta roja directa, dejando a su equipo con diez hombres en el tramo definitivo del partido y profundizando el complicado momento deportivo que atraviesa el artillero cafetero. La expulsión y la consecuente sanción llegan en el peor momento posible para Viveros. El atacante venía siendo una de las grandes sensaciones de la temporada en Brasil gracias a su impresionante registro goleador (superando la barrera de los 20 tantos e igualando marcas históricas), lo que lo catapultó a los primeros lugares de la tabla de artilleros. Sin embargo, el panorama actual cambió drásticamente. El delantero colombiano acumula varias jornadas sin ver portería, cortando la racha estelar que venía firmando. El Tribunal de Disciplina analiza el informe arbitral por conducta violenta, lo que podría acarrearle varios partidos de suspensión. El Athletico Paranaense perderá a su carta de ataque en un tramo clave del campeonato. Las críticas en la prensa y redes sociales de Brasil no se han hecho esperar, cuestionando la reacción del delantero en un momento donde su equipo más necesitaba de su jerarquía ofensiva. Mientras el comité disciplinario emite el fallo oficial con los partidos exactos de suspensión, el cuerpo técnico del Athletico Paranaense deberá replantear su esquema ofensivo para sortear la ausencia de Viveros, quien tendrá que trabajar en el aspecto psicológico y físico para regresar con mayor mesura y reencontrarse con su mejor versión goleadora.

articles.title: Raymond van Barneveld secures World Darts Championship spot as Tommy Morris stuns Luke Humphries in Players Championship 34
articles.summary: Raymond van Barneveld ensured he will be at Alexandra Palace next month as the final Players Championship event took place in Leicester; Tommy Morris stunned Luke Humphries in the final to also book a World Championship spot while Ricky Evans will need to come through qualifying
articles.body:
England's Morris defeated Humphries 8-5 in the final of Players Championship 34 by winning the last three legs, sealing victory with a 161 checkout.

It means he has qualified for the Grand Slam of Darts, which takes place from November 14-22, and next month's World Darts Championship, both live on Sky Sports.

"You have no idea, I'm so happy!" said Morris, who was overcome with emotion.

"I've come from nothing. I haven't even got a tour card. For me to come here and do that, I'm just flying my flag from where I live and doing it for my family. I don't even know what's going on.

"I had a target at the start of the year to reach the Worlds and now my next target is to get a tour card and be with these boys full time. I've won nothing. For me to win one of these PDC events is very overwhelming for me."

Earlier on, darts legend Van Barneveld ensured he will be at Alexandra Palace by securing his place as one of the next highest 40 players on the one-year ProTour Order of Merit ranking, as the top 40 on the two-year rankings qualify automatically.

Van Barneveld beat Dutch compatriot Jimmy van Schie in his opening match, which was enough to reach the World Championship for a record 34th time in his career.

However, crowd favourite Ricky Evans will need to come through a tour-card-holder qualifier to be at Alexandra Palace after an early exit on Thursday.

Evans needed a strong run but lost 6-0 in the second round to Morris, while Dutch players Wesley Plaisier and Jeffrey de Zwaan will also need to come through qualifying matches.

Players Championship 34 - Results from quarter-finals onwards

Quarter-Finals Tommy Morris 6-3 Jermaine Wattimena Cristo Reyes 6-5 Kim Huybrechts Luke Humpries 6-3 Michael van Gerwen Jack Aldridge 6-4 Danny Noppert

Semi-Finals Tommy Morris 7-4 Cristo Reyes Luke Humphries 7-5 Jack Aldridge

Who has qualified for the Players Championship Finals?

The main purpose of the 34 indoor Players Championship events that have been held over the last nine months is to set a 64-player field for the Players Championship Finals, which take place in Minehead at the end of this month.

The top 64 from this season's Players Championship Order of Merit qualify, and some big names have missed out.

Luke Littler did not enter enough events to qualify, a decision he took after his quarter-final exit at the World Series Finals in September, so he will not defend his title.

Nathan Aspinall has missed out, while Josh Rock's second-round defeat on Thursday means he has also not qualified.

Although Van Barneveld secured a spot at the World Championship, he will not feature at the Players Championship Finals, and neither will former world champion Peter Wright.

Gary Anderson squeaked through after his quarter-final run in Players Championship 33, which was backed up with a first-round win on Thursday, while former world champions Gerwyn Price and Michael Smith also just did enough.

World No 2 Humphries will be the favourite for the tournament, while Dutch star Wessel Nijman is the top seed after his six Players Championship event wins this year.

Fan favourites Michael van Gerwen, James Wade and Stephen Bunting are in the field, as is Welsh No 2 Jonny Clayton.

When are the Players Championship Finals?

The Players Championship Finals will take place at Butlins in Minehead from November 27-29.

The winner of the event takes home £130,000, with a total prize pot of £750,000 on the line for the 64 players.

The World Youth Championship final between Cam Crabtree and Jan Schmidt will be played on the same weekend on November 29.

articles.title: El video de Gustavo Petro con Deyci Jiménez que sacude la política: los contratos y las claves del caso
articles.standfirst: Quién es Deyci Jiménez y su relación con Gustavo Petro: los contratos y datos clave del video
articles.summary: Quién es Deyci Jiménez y su relación con Gustavo Petro: los contratos y datos clave del video
articles.body: La difusión de un video de 54 segundos entre Deicy Jiménez y el expresidente Gustavo Petro reavivó una de las controversias judiciales y políticas más sensibles de Colombia: la acusación de que contratos públicos habrían sido utilizados para obtener favores sexuales. Hasta ahora, no hay una condena ni una conclusión judicial: existen contratos documentados, una denuncia, investigaciones en curso y una fuerte disputa sobre el valor probatorio del material audiovisual. Deicy Alejandra Jiménez Ramírez, de 26 años y excontratista del Estado, sostiene que conoció a Petro en 2019, cuando él era senador, y que posteriormente mantuvo una relación con él. Según su versión, recibió contratos en entidades públicas a cambio de encuentros sexuales y afirma que entre 30 y 40 mujeres habrían participado en esquemas similares. Jiménez señala que los contratos habrían abarcado aproximadamente cinco años, incluyendo el período en que Petro era senador y su posterior presidencia. También asegura que el video publicado busca demostrar la existencia de una relación íntima previa entre ambos. El material fue publicado el miércoles 4 de noviembre de 2026 en la cuenta de Instagram de Jiménez. Tiene una duración de 54 segundos y muestra una conversación y un beso entre la denunciante y el expresidente; Jiménez lo presenta como evidencia del vínculo personal que alega. Sin embargo, la existencia de una relación personal, incluso si fuera confirmada, no prueba por sí sola una irregularidad contractual. El punto jurídico central es establecer si hubo una conexión entre esa relación y la adjudicación, ejecución o pago de contratos públicos. Los registros del Sistema Electrónico para la Contratación Pública, SECOP, muestran que Jiménez tuvo contratos con entidades estatales. La investigación se concentra en cinco contratos por más de 100 millones de pesos, vinculados al Ministerio del Interior, el Senado —durante la gestión de María José Pizarro—, la Superintendencia de Vigilancia y Seguridad Privada y un acuerdo proyectado en el Dapre. Una revisión citada por medios internacionales identificó diez contratos en SECOP por 133,5 millones de pesos. Siete, por cerca de 116,9 millones, corresponden a agosto de 2022 y agosto de 2026; los otros tres fueron suscritos en 2021 y comienzos de 2022, cuando Petro aún era senador. Petro negó haber usado contratos estatales para obtener favores sexuales. En sus comunicados sostuvo: “Nunca usé un contrato del Estado para obtener favores de nadie”, y afirmó que las mujeres que trabajaron en su gobierno llegaron por su capacidad y esfuerzo. El expresidente no negó conocer a Jiménez, pero sí rechazó la interpretación de que existiera una relación entre encuentros privados y contratación pública. Respecto del video, argumentó que no ha sido examinado por peritos ni valorado por un juez, y que en él no aparece un contrato, un pago ni una decisión de gobierno. El abogado Alejandro Carranza, representante de Petro, cuestionó que el video carezca de fecha, lugar y origen verificable. Solicitó que su autenticidad, integridad, contexto y alcance sean establecidos mediante peritaje y dentro de un proceso con garantías para todas las partes. Esta objeción es jurídicamente relevante: un video puede servir como elemento de investigación, pero su fuerza probatoria depende de su cadena de custodia, autenticidad, fecha, contexto y relación con los hechos denunciados. La defensa sostiene que, mientras eso no ocurra, el material no constituye prueba definitiva. La Fiscalía General de la Nación abrió una investigación penal el 23 de octubre, tras las declaraciones de Jiménez sobre supuestos pagos de favores sexuales mediante contratos públicos. La Procuraduría también abrió una indagación previa para identificar posibles responsabilidades disciplinarias en el Congreso, el Dapre, el Ministerio del Interior y otras entidades. Jiménez ya rindió declaración ante la Corte Suprema de Justicia. Además, la Fiscalía citaría inicialmente a declarar a exfuncionarias del gobierno Petro, entre ellas Laura Sarabia y Angie Rodríguez. Varios exfiscales generales coincidieron en que el caso debería tramitarse ante la justicia penal ordinaria y no ante la Comisión de Acusaciones de la Cámara de Representantes. Entre las conductas que podrían analizarse mencionaron peculado, falsedad en documento público, trata de personas e inducción a la prostitución, aunque estas son hipótesis investigativas y no conclusiones. La distinción importa: que existan contratos no implica ilegalidad; y que exista una relación personal tampoco demuestra corrupción. La investigación deberá determinar si hubo una utilización indebida de recursos públicos, falsificación o uso irregular de certificaciones, presión sobre funcionarios, o si los contratos cumplieron los requisitos legales. Según allegados de Jiménez citados por El Tiempo, el teléfono visible en el video contendría pruebas adicionales. Se habrían recopilado copias espejo de seguridad para entregarlas a las autoridades, junto con testimonios de terceros vinculados a la administración anterior. También se han mencionado chats filtrados y reportes periodísticos según los cuales una certificación usada para la vinculación de Jiménez habría carecido de autorización oficial. Este punto podría ser decisivo, porque una certificación irregular puede abrir una línea de investigación distinta a la del supuesto intercambio de favores. Más allá de la dimensión política, el caso toca un principio básico de la administración pública: los contratos estatales deben adjudicarse por mérito, necesidad del servicio y procedimientos legales, no por relaciones personales ni favores privados. Si se comprobara una vinculación entre favores sexuales y contratación pública, las consecuencias podrían incluir responsabilidad penal, disciplinaria y política. Por ahora, el escándalo se encuentra en una etapa inicial. El video puede cambiar la percepción pública porque muestra proximidad entre los protagonistas, pero la decisión judicial dependerá de pruebas verificables: contratos, comunicaciones, certificaciones, testimonios, peritajes y el contexto exacto de cada adjudicación.

articles.title: New WWE Rumors Reveal The Rock's 30th Anniversary Celebration with New Title Belt Plans & More
articles.summary: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson made his then-WWF in-ring debut at the 1996 Survivor Series as Rocky Maivia. Three decades later, The Rock stands as one of the most electrifying and exciting entertainers and performers in pro wrestling history.
articles.body:
Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson made his then-WWF in-ring debut at the 1996 Survivor Series as Rocky Maivia. Three decades later, The Rock stands as one of the most electrifying and exciting entertainers and performers in pro wrestling history.

Per WrestleVotes Radio on Fightful Select, WWE plans to honor the 30th anniversary of Johnson's debut in numerous ways.

November (and specifically Survivor Series) has long been an important month for the Rock's WWE history.

Not only did he debut there in 1996, but The Rock won his first-ever world championship at the 1998 Survivor Series, when he beat Mankind to win the Deadly Game single-elimination tournament.

After winning in a finish reminiscent of the Montreal Screwjob at the 1997 Survivor Series, The Rock made his heel turn and aligned with Vince and Shane McMahon as the new Corporate champion.

In 2011, The Rock and John Cena beat The Miz and R-Truth in a tag team match, with The Rock pinning the Miz after the People's Elbow.

However, The Rock gave the Rock Bottom to Cena after the match, laying further groundwork for a feud that saw the two men battle in the main event at the following WrestleMania (XXVIII). The Rock won that 30-minute match.

Overall, The Rock is an eight-time world champion and five-time Intercontinental champion, and he was one of the top champions and performers during the Attitude Era, so it makes sense for the WWE to honor him in the present date.

It'll be interesting to see if The Rock appears on WWE programming as part of the celebration. He last appeared on television at the 2025 Elimination Chamber, when John Cena aligned with the Rock, went heel and turned on Cody Rhodes by ruthlessly attacking him.

In the present date, The Rock remains a fixture in Hollywood. He is currently shooting the film, Lizard Music , directed by Benny Safdie.

articles.title: España y Argentina ya están en semifinales… y reservan a sus estrellas
articles.standfirst: España y Argentina ya están en semifinales… y reservan a sus estrellas
articles.summary: España y Argentina ya están en semifinales… y reservan a sus estrellas
articles.body: El Mundial de pádel llega a su término y lo hace en dirección a la final esperada por todos. Argentina y España, principales favoritas en ambas categorías, han superado la ronda de cuartos de final sin ningún problema y ya escriben su nombre entre las cuatro mejores selecciones del torneo. Además, pese a tratarse ya de eliminatorias, sus entrenadores decidieron dar descanso a dos de las principales figuras de cada combinado como son Agustín Tapia y Juan Lebrón. Los de Juanjo Gutiérrez pasaron por encima de una Brasil que ni siquiera alineó a Lucas Bergamini, su mejor jugador. Empezó ‘La Roja’ con Coki Nieto y Jon Sanz ganando con solvencia por un doble 6-2. Continuaron Arturo Coello y Javi Leal en el segundo punto, que vencieron por un contundente 6-2 y 6-1. El tercer partido, que le correspondía al ‘Lobo’ y Aimar Goñi, terminó por no disputarse al llegar a un acuerdo con los rivales con la eliminatoria ya resuelta. Por su parte, Argentina arrancó su cruce ante Alemania —que hizo historia al meterse en cuartos por primera vez con Agustín Reca, hijo del seleccionador albiceleste, a la cabeza— con Gonza Alfonso y Fede Chingotto. El ‘Ratón’ y el de General Cabrera se lo llevaron con un claro 6-1 y 6-1. Justo después saltaron a la pista Martín Di Nenno y Leo Augsburger para ganar por 6-0 y 6-4, cerrando el duelo definitivo Maxi Arce y Franco Stupaczuk con un rotundo 6-3 y 6-0. Avanzan sin sufrimiento ambas selecciones, que ya vislumbran las semifinales: a España le toca medirse a Portugal, mientras que Argentina se verá las caras con unos italianos que están rindiendo a un gran nivel, aunque los pronósticos apuntan a un pase sin sobresaltos. En el cuadro femenino, España continúa imponiendo su ley con mano de hierro. Paula Josemaría y Bea González abrieron el fuego, continuaron Marta Ortega y Martina Calvo, y cerraron la jornada la dupla formada por Andrea Ustero y Ari Sánchez. Tres combinaciones de auténticas garantías que se postulan como opciones fijas para buscar el título. Todas ellas saldaron sus encuentros con total solvencia frente al conjunto sueco. Argentina hizo lo propio ante una Portugal cuyo papel en este Mundial está siendo algo decepcionante, a pesar de estar lideradas por una Sofía Araujo que brilla habitualmente en Premier Padel. Las albicelestes repitieron alineación con Delfi Brea junto a Claudia Jensen, Aranza Osoro con Martina Fassio y Virginia Riera con Julieta Bidahorria. Al igual que los chicos, se medirán en semifinales a Italia, mientras que las de Carolina Navarro se citarán con Francia por un puesto en la gran final.

Florida Panthers stars Brad Marchand and Aleksander Barkov signed the team's new JetBlue themed jet on Thursday, christening it before it takes flight.

The new plane is named "Go Cats Go," to honor the two-time Stanley Cup champions and was unveiled in a ceremony at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport.

It is the first Panthers-themed aircraft livery for the franchise, which has seen hockey continue to gain new audience throughout South Florida.

"It's not a plane that you're gonna miss. It stands out," Marchand said in a team press release. "They did an incredible job with it. During the press conference, Barky and I were talking about the back of the plane and how the Panther logo up there is incredible. Yeah, it's really special to have something like this."

"It's a great thing to see, for sure," Barkov said in a statement about the growth of hockey in South Florida. "Like you see [our logo] more and more. When you think that you can't see it more, then they come up with a plane. It's been great. Every single day here since I joined the organization, I feel like we've been taking steps forward. I'm just looking forward to many more things to come."

articles.title: JJ McCarthy Swipes at O’Connell After Vikings Shelve Kyler Murray
articles.summary: New York Giants QB JJ McCarthy appears to have taken a jab at Minnesota Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell after he sidelined Kyler Murray. The post JJ McCar...
articles.body:
The Minnesota Vikings are moving Kyler Murray to the bench this week against the Buffalo Bills, while JJ McCarthy prepares to start his second contest for the New York Giants in Philadelphia — and the mud on this particular set of circumstances happens to be thick.

Major questions exist as to whether minor hamstring tightness — which did not require Murray to leave the game against the Detroit Lions last week — is the real reason for Carson Wentz's promotion to QB1 in Minnesota this week, or if it's because Murray has struggled mightily and the likes of Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison are starting to display their frustrations publicly.

And while Minnesota and Murray are attempting to navigate their first loss of the season, McCarthy has suddenly found himself the starter on an NFC division leader and coming off a 20-of-28 performance for 252 yards and zero turnovers against a talented Houston Texans defense.

Never one who appeared to lack for confidence, McCarthy met with media members in New York on Wednesday, November 4 ahead of a showdown with the Eagles (2-6) and spoke glowingly of Giants offensive coordinator Matt Nagy and his system.

Some have taken those comments as a backhanded slight against Vikings head coach and play-caller Kevin O'Connell , who backed off what had been ardent support for McCarthy in 2025 before the team's new general manager, Nolan Teasley, traded the 23-year-old QB for a paltry fifth-round pick in late September.

JJ McCarthy's Effusive Praise for Matt Nagy Could Come Off as Insult to Kevin O'Connell

McCarthy, now 1-0 as a starter in New York and coming off five strong quarters plus a bye week to rest and prepare for a banged-up Philly squad, had the following to say to reporters on Thursday.

"I absolutely love his play calling and how he adapts with the flow of the game," McCarthy said of Nagy . "Like, he has a beautiful idea and vision going into the game, and most of the time it carries out."

"There's times where he's got to pivot, and seeing him pivot in the last month that I've been here, it's been really exciting to see and just an honor to play for him and go execute the football plays with the ten guys with me in that huddle," McCarthy added. "Gonna continue to do that."

Vikings Coaches Aware of Fallout Coming if JJ McCarthy Plays Well in New York, Kyler Murray Flounders in Minnesota

Meanwhile, multiple members of the Vikings' coaching staff spoke with Dan Graziano of ESPN last week in Detroit about McCarthy's new opportunity in New York and the potential fallout if he continues to play well and Murray keeps on struggling.

"Minnesota coaches told me they believed McCarthy had matured significantly since the start of the 2026 offseason … and they were happy the team had been able to send him to a place where he had a chance to be successful," Graziano wrote .

"They also recognize they have a chance to look bad if McCarthy plays well for the Giants and Kyler Murray doesn't get things going in Minnesota, but everyone agrees it was time for a scenery change," Graziano continued.

articles.title: George Russell opens up on mental exhaustion after frustrating 2026 F1 season
articles.summary: George Russell has admitted he is mentally exhausted after a frustrating 2026 Formula 1 season marked by repeated setbacks and bad luck
articles.body:
George Russell has admitted he is mentally exhausted after a season in which he has repeatedly had to overcome challenges.

The Mercedes driver started 2026 as the favourite for the title, but after a string of issues outside of his control and incredible performances from his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, he watched on as the Italian became world champion in Mexico.

Speaking to the media at Interlagos on Thursday, Russell said that even reaching Brazil, where he celebrated his first Formula 1 win in 2022, had not lifted him.

"As I said, I probably just feel a bit exhausted this season of constantly picking myself back up," he said. "When you get kicked to the ground, you pick yourself back up, then you get kicked down again, you pick yourself back up and I was hoping to do that maybe twice in the season not every other weekend, really.

"When you get to a point of this season, you're away from home for three weeks in a row and you have another race like what happened in Mexico where a chance of victory, a chance at the podium just disappears totally outside of your control, is tough to deal with. It's very tough to deal with.

"So Brazil was a place that I love. I've got great memories. Do I come in with high expectations? Honestly, no. But looking forward to next year, for sure."

The Briton revealed he had gone back through the whole season with his engineers after Mexico and found that only six races had been free of problems.

"14 of those races, we've had things that have been what we thought was bad luck," he said. "But we need to start questioning things more deeply when it's happening so often, and especially on our side."

Russell is currently fourth in the drivers' standings on 250 points, 11 points behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen , who sits second on 261 points, and nine points behind Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton , who sits third on 259 points.

articles.title: Charlotte edges Middleburg in volleyball semis
articles.summary: Middleburg volleyball fell to Charlotte in the Class 5A state semifinals after a hard-fought five set match.
articles.body:
Middleburg's quest for a second state volleyball trophy must wait for another year.

Fighting back from the brink of elimination, Charlotte turned the tables and defeated the Broncos 19-25, 25-18, 21-25, 25-23, 15-12 in the Florida High School Athletic Association Class 5A volleyball semifinal on Nov. 5 at Polk State College in Winter Haven.

Charlotte's Dakota Galley delivered the winning point to end the last hopes of the Broncos, who had survived four match points.

Middleburg, the 2023 state champion, held a 7-4 lead in the final set before the Fighting Tarpons (23-8) stormed in front with a 8-0 run to set up a 1 p.m. championship match on Nov. 7 against Archbishop McCarthy or Viera.

The Broncos (19-12) jumped ahead early before the Fighting Tarpons, boosted by 22 kills from Sammy Vega, closed out the second on a kill from Nikaila Price.

From there, in a back-and-forth third set, Middleburg pulled back in front at the finish to finish on consecutive kills from Abbie Grybb and Katelynn Laezza. But Charlotte clawed back from an 11-6 deficit to win the fourth, before pushing past Middleburg in the fifth.

Maysie Bader led with 17 kills and Laezza had 16 for Middleburg, while Amelia Cobb supplied 21 assists and Reese Forkum recorded 32 digs.

The Broncos are set to return most of their lineup for 2027, with Bader and setter Allie Anschuetz the only seniors on the squad.

The Buffalo Bills are coming off a win against the Baltimore Ravens, but they could have some problems heading into their Monday night matchup against the Minnesota Vikings . Buffalo opened its practice week Thursday with several important players missing from the field, including offensive linemen Dion Dawkins and Alec Anderson.

The Bills have a lengthy injury report to manage, and losing multiple starters along the offensive line would be a concern against Minnesota's defense. Josh Allen is capable of making plays under pressure, but facing Brian Flores ' aggressive defensive scheme without a fully healthy offensive line could make his job much more difficult.

Flores is known for bringing pressure from different angles and keeping opposing quarterbacks guessing. The Vikings frequently use blitz packages to disrupt the pocket, which could create problems for an offensive line dealing with multiple injuries.

Dawkins and Anderson were not the only Bills players who missed Thursday's practice. Wide receiver Josh Palmer, running back Ty Johnson and defensive tackle Greg Gaines were out. Meanwhile, Dalton Kincaid, DJ Moore, Keon Coleman and Spencer Brown were among the players who were limited.

There are still several days before Buffalo travels to Minnesota, giving the team time to get some of its players back on the field. However, the Bills will need to monitor their offensive line closely, especially with the challenge Flores presents.

Monday night should be a compelling matchup between two teams with Super Bowl aspirations. Both the Bills and Vikings have established themselves as contenders in their respective conferences, and this game could have major implications moving forward.

Buffalo has the talent to come away with another win, but Allen could have his hands full if the offensive line cannot get healthy in time.

articles.title: Mercedes held its breath over Kimi Antonelli’s title-winning move on Charles Leclerc
articles.summary: The new world champion only needed ninth in Mexico, but says he wanted to “clinch the title with a good race”, even as a cracked sump nearly stopped him in t...

All Kimi Antonelli needed to do at the Mexico City Grand Prix was finish ninth. Instead, the new world champion chose to clinch the title with a late-braking lunge on Charles Leclerc into Turn 1, and not everyone at Mercedes was comfortable watching it.

Speaking on the Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show , Antonelli revealed that some members of the team questioned why he had taken the risk, with the championship already within touching distance.

Host Anthony Davidson said the move had left the team "holding their breath", describing it as "necessary but not necessary at the same time".

"Some of them, they were like, 'Couldn't you have just stayed behind?'" Antonelli laughed. "But of course, I wanted to finish on the podium. I wanted to clinch the title with a good race. I didn't want to just clinch it by doing the normal job, which was OK, finish ninth."

Antonelli believes he had more than a podium in him before the race was stopped. Running an offset strategy in the first stint, he said he was set up for a strong second half of the race on much fresher tyres.

"I really believe that after the pitstop we could have even fought for maybe a win, because the pace was very strong and the car was feeling great," he said.

The red flag reset the field, leaving him fourth for the restart with everyone on fresh tyres. Antonelli said he saw it as a chance, and took third place from Leclerc to finish behind Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton .

The risk did not end there, either. Mercedes has since revealed that Antonelli was close to retiring with an oil leak in the closing laps.

That willingness to attack, even with the title on the line, is a far cry from the driver who struggled through spells of his rookie season in 2025.

"I'm not going to lie, I've been questioning myself over and over again last season during that stretch," Antonelli admitted on the same show.

He said being put straight into a Mercedes made it harder, because he was "much more under the spotlight", but credited those difficult moments, including a bad home race at Monza last year, with speeding up his development.

"Looking back, I'm very glad that I went through all that difficult moments, because I think they shaped me. They made me grow a lot faster. They made me mature a lot faster," the 20-year-old said.

A year on, he took the title with four races to spare, beating team-mate George Russell , and he did not want to do it by playing safe.

articles.title: Mets rumors: 2 starters New York could pivot to if Tarik Skubal signs elsewhere
articles.summary: The New York Mets couldn’t have had a worse season in 2026, finishing in last place in the National League East. Owner Steve Cohen has designs on his team wi...
articles.body:
The New York Mets couldn't have had a worse season in 2026, finishing in last place in the National League East. Owner Steve Cohen has designs on his team winning World Series titles and demonstrating that the Mets are a perennial contender, but the team had a brutal start to the season and was never able to turn things around.

One thing Mets fans believe they can count on is that Cohen will keep trying to put a championship team on the field. The owner's contribution includes going after the most valuable — and usually expensive — free agents that hit the market.

As free agency gets underway, the best free agent available will be dominant pitcher Tarik Skubal. The Detroit Tigers traded him prior to the MLB deadline last season to the Los Angeles Dodgers. Many expected that move to help the Dodgers win their third straight World Series. That did not happen as the small-market Milwaukee Brewers dominated the postseason, swept the Dodgers and won the World Series.

The Mets are expected to go after Skubal and hope to bring him to Citi Field. However, if the Mets are not successful, the Mets may try to address their pitching needs by going after a couple of other free agents.

The question was addressed on the Mets Podcast, hosted by Joe DeMayo and Sal Licata, and the participants discussed the possibility of signing Michael King or Clay Holmes. Both hosts favored Holmes because they were more familiar with his work with the Yankees, Mets and Cubs, and they liked his consistency on the mound. However, high marks were also given to King for his strong postseason with the Padres.
